Dreame L10s Ultra replacement parts.

This guide covers the original U.S. Dreame L10s Ultra robot and its auto-empty, mop-wash base. It does not cover the L10s Ultra Gen 2, L10s Pro Ultra Heat or L10s Pro Ultra; their parts and dock accessories can differ.

Check the variant: Check the exact model name in the Dreamehome app or on the robot. The L10s Ultra Gen 2 and L10s Pro Ultra Heat have separate official accessory listings; a broad seller claim or shared Dreame name does not prove every component fits.

Fit: The seller explicitly names the original Dreame L10s Ultra. Dreame's manual confirms that this robot uses a filter in its dust bin.

Dreame L10s Ultra replacement main brush

2 rubber roller brushes, according to the Amazon listing.

View main brushes on Amazon ↗

Fit: The seller lists the L10s Ultra by name, and Dreame's accessory catalog lists its regular rubber brush for the original model.

Replace when: Dreame recommends replacing the main brush every 6–12 months. First remove wrapped hair and debris; replace it if the roller or end fittings are worn or damaged.

Before buying: This is a third-party roller, not Dreame's newer TriCut brush. Compare the full-width roller and end fittings with your original part; do not use the model name alone to infer fit for another generation.

EXACT-MODEL FIT

What is shared, and what needs checking?

Original L10s Ultra vs. Gen 2 / Pro Ultra Heat
Dreame lists the original L10s Ultra, L10s Ultra Gen 2 and L10s Pro Ultra Heat as separate models. The linked 24-piece kit explicitly excludes Gen 2 and Pro Ultra Heat. Check each component listing and your exact model before ordering.
Original dock dust bags
Dreame's 3 L L10s Ultra/L20 Ultra bags are a different product from the 3.2 L bags listed for later models including L10s Ultra Gen 2. Match the bag collar and dock track; do not rely on capacity or a broad 'Dreame Ultra' claim alone.
Robot-bin filter vs. dock dust bag
The reusable filter sits in the robot's dust bin. The disposable bag fits inside the base station. They are separate parts, with separate fit checks and replacement intervals.
Mop cloth vs. holder
The L10s Ultra has two rotating round mop pads attached to holders. The linked six-pack contains cloth pads only; it is not a pair of mop holders or a motorized mop assembly.
CLEAN FIRST, REPLACE WHEN NEEDED

Dreame L10s Ultra maintenance intervals

The manufacturer’s published care guidance for this model gives these intervals. Wear and your cleaning routine can change when a part needs replacement; follow the replacement manufacturer’s care instructions too.

Dreame L10s Ultra cleaning and replacement intervals
PartCleanReplace
Rubber main brushEvery 2 weeksEvery 6–12 months
Side brushMonthlyEvery 3–6 months
Dust-bin filterEvery 2 weeksEvery 3–6 months
Mop padsAuto-washed by dock after returnEvery 1–3 months
Dock dust bagDisposable; app notificationEvery 6–8 weeks

Rinse the filter with clean water only and let it dry completely before reinstalling it. Remove hair from both ends of the main brush before replacing it. The base washes mop pads automatically; inspect them and clean as needed. The app can notify you when the dock bag is due; actual replacement timing depends on use.

Before you order

Do L10s Ultra Gen 2 replacement parts fit the original L10s Ultra?

Do not assume they do. Dreame lists these as separate models, and some accessories differ: for example, the original L10s Ultra uses a 3 L dust bag, while Dreame lists 3.2 L bags for later models such as Gen 2. Check every component against the full model name.

Which dust bag fits the original Dreame L10s Ultra?

Dreame lists an original L10s Ultra/L20 Ultra bag with 3 L capacity. The third-party 10-pack linked here names the original L10s Ultra and also states 3 L. Compare the bag collar and slide-in track with your original before ordering.

How often should I replace the L10s Ultra filter and brushes?

Dreame's routine-maintenance table gives 3–6 months for the dust-bin filter, 6–12 months for the main brush and 3–6 months for the side brush. Cleaning frequency and wear can change the timing; use the app's reminders and inspect parts regularly.

Are these genuine Dreame parts?

No. The linked filters, roller, bags, mop pads and 24-piece kit are third-party listings. Dreame's catalog and manual support the model and part type, while fit statements and pack contents for those Amazon products come from their sellers.
